summary: Frontend-only regression validation completed for Landing, Profile, and Contact pages on the public URL. All requested navigation, links, download, copy, focus, and responsive checks passed.
action_items: No blocking fixes required from this run.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: ResumeDownload blob-download path works on Landing/Profile/Contact and fallback label switches to 'Open resume PDF' on controlled fetch failure.
Good: Contact links use safe external-tab attributes (target='_blank' + rel='noopener noreferrer') and exact expected social URLs.
No critical code-quality or integration defects found in scoped files for this request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://portfolio-landing-96.preview.emergentagent.com with Playwright: Landing resume download + tel CTA, Profile tools/history/logo loads, Contact email/phone href, social href safety, copy success and denial messages, route titles/reload behavior, scroll reset Profile->Contact, responsive no-horizontal-overflow at 1920x800, 1920x1259, 768x1024, 390x844, 320x700, and successful yarn build. Note: one PDF net::ERR_FAILED console line was intentionally induced by test route-abort to verify fallback; repeated __emergent_overlay__/report and cdn-cgi/rum aborts are environment noise.
rca of the issue: No production defect reproduced in this scoped run. Controlled negative testing used temporary test-time mocks to verify graceful behavior for clipboard denial and resume download failure.
